subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the four guard expectations are repaired and exact-head checks pass, does the security owner approve this grouped set of official immutable action revisions?
rationale: The patch defects are mechanical, but the protected security label and CODEOWNERS-governed privileged workflow changes require explicit owner approval that automation cannot supply.

options.title: Approve after guard repair
options.body: Keep the grouped updates and land after assertion synchronization, rebase, exact-head checks, and security-owner review.

options.title: Split privileged action families
options.body: Separate token, Docker, CodeQL, and Codex action updates for narrower approval and rollout boundaries.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Defer the PR if a stable reviewed head or security-owner approval cannot be obtained.

recommendation.title: Approve after guard repair
